title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
why_it_matters: Canonical PD-disaggregation system and one of the clearest TTFT/TPOT goodput framings.
limitation: Mostly studies phase split; operator-level AFD is outside scope.

title: Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting
why_it_matters: Early and influential argument for serving prefill and decode on different hardware tiers.
limitation: Static phase-splitting model does not cover newer AFD/MoE operator splits.

title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Turns KV cache into the central disaggregation primitive and releases production-style traces.
limitation: KV-centric phase disaggregation; not a full AFD system.

title: Inference without Interference: Disaggregate LLM Inference for Mixed Downstream Workloads
why_it_matters: Studies interference between heterogeneous inference workloads under disaggregated serving.
limitation: Less central than DistServe and Splitwise for the AFD line.

title: MemServe: Context Caching for Disaggregated LLM Serving with Elastic Memory Pool
why_it_matters: Explores elastic memory pooling for context reuse in disaggregated serving.
limitation: Primarily state-centric rather than operator-centric.

title: LoongServe: Efficiently Serving Long-Context Large Language Models with Elastic Sequence Parallelism
why_it_matters: Shows long-context serving stresses static placement and motivates elastic execution.
limitation: Sequence-parallel long-context serving is adjacent to, not identical with, AFD.

title: P/D-Serve: Serving Disaggregated Large Language Model at Scale
why_it_matters: Studies practical issues in scaling PD-disaggregated serving.
limitation: Does not address attention/FFN operator disaggregation.

title: DejaVu: KV-cache Streaming for Fast, Fault-tolerant Generative LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Makes KV streaming and fault tolerance first-class serving concerns.
limitation: Not focused on MoE or AFD.

title: Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
why_it_matters: Dynamic migration and scheduling are important building blocks for elastic disaggregation.
limitation: General serving scheduler rather than a dedicated disaggregation architecture.

title: MegaScale-Infer: Serving Mixture-of-Experts at Scale with Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
why_it_matters: Foundational system paper making attention/FFN and expert disaggregation concrete at production scale.
limitation: Relies on static provisioning and strong communication assumptions.

title: Step-3 is Large yet Affordable: Model-System Co-design for Cost-effective Decoding
why_it_matters: A production-oriented AFD design paired with an open communication library.
limitation: Model-specific co-design; the linked StepMesh artifact is its communication library, not a complete serving reproduction.

title: StepMesh: A High-Performance, Low-Latency Communication Library for Attention-FFN Disaggregation
why_it_matters: One of the clearest open-source communication substrates built specifically for AFD.
limitation: Library-level artifact; end-to-end serving claims depend on integration.

title: JANUS: Disaggregating Attention and Experts for Scalable MoE Inference
why_it_matters: Extends the attention/expert disaggregation line beyond MegaScale-Infer.
limitation: Open questions remain around dynamic placement, jitter, and multi-rack behavior.

title: Efficient MoE Inference with Fine-Grained Scheduling of Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
why_it_matters: Targets scheduling inefficiencies inside disaggregated expert-parallel inference.
limitation: Builds on the DEP premise rather than resolving when DEP should be used.

title: Injecting Adrenaline into LLM Serving: Boosting Resource Utilization and Throughput via Attention Disaggregation
why_it_matters: A partial-AFD design that offloads attention work to improve utilization.
limitation: Offloading ratio and synchronization costs remain difficult to generalize.

title: Analytical Provisioning for Attention-FFN Disaggregated LLM Serving under Stochastic Workloads
why_it_matters: Provides an analytical framework for A/F ratio provisioning under stochastic workloads.
limitation: Theory needs broader validation under real systems, online adaptation, and fabric constraints.

title: Revealing the Challenges of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Modern MoE Models and Hardware Systems
why_it_matters: Important boundary study showing when AFD fails due to communication and imbalance.
limitation: Primarily analysis; mitigation remains open.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
why_it_matters: Production-scale MoE inference reference that motivates AFD and DEP designs.
limitation: System details are only partially public.

title: DeepEP: An Efficient Expert-Parallel Communication Library
why_it_matters: Widely referenced communication substrate for large MoE inference.
limitation: Communication primitive, not a full serving policy.

title: SARATHI: Efficient LLM Inference by Piggybacking Decodes with Chunked Prefills
why_it_matters: Core counter-argument that co-located chunked prefill can avoid disaggregation overhead.
limitation: Does not separately provision memory-heavy and compute-heavy resources.

title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
why_it_matters: Strong production-style baseline against PD disaggregation.
limitation: Does not expose an A/F provisioning knob.

title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Argues that aggregation and disaggregation should be unified rather than treated as binary choices.
limitation: AFD-specific operator split is not the main target.

title: Towards High-Goodput LLM Serving with Prefill-decode Multiplexing
why_it_matters: Strengthens the case that smart multiplexing can compete with physical disaggregation.
limitation: Not designed for MoE attention/FFN separation.

title: Nexus: Proactive Intra-GPU Disaggregation of Prefill and Decode in LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Shows disaggregation can be logical or intra-GPU, not only physical inter-node separation.
limitation: Different cost model from rack-scale PD or AFD.

title: FlowKV: A Disaggregated Inference Framework with Low-Latency KV Cache Transfer and Load-Aware Scheduling
why_it_matters: Targets the state-transfer bottleneck that constrains PD and AFD systems.
limitation: KV transfer improvement does not alone solve operator provisioning.

title: CacheGen: KV Cache Compression and Streaming for Fast Large Language Model Serving
why_it_matters: Compression and streaming are essential when disaggregation turns KV into network traffic.
limitation: Focuses on KV cache rather than broader split decisions.

title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Makes cache reuse a reusable serving layer.
limitation: AFD integration remains an open design question.

title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with CachedAttention
why_it_matters: Shows conversation-level cache reuse changes serving economics.
limitation: Disaggregated placement is not the main focus.

title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
why_it_matters: Connects cache reuse with RAG serving, a workload class that stresses disaggregated state.
limitation: RAG-specific; not a general AFD system.

title: Stateful Large Language Model Serving with Pensieve
why_it_matters: Frames long-lived state as a first-class serving primitive.
limitation: Does not resolve attention/FFN provisioning.

title: RAGCache: Efficient Knowledge Caching for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
why_it_matters: Important adjacent work for cache-heavy serving workloads.
limitation: RAG-centric rather than disaggregation-centric.

title: Infinite-LLM: Efficient LLM Service for Long Context with DistAttention and Distributed KVCache
why_it_matters: Long-context serving amplifies the need for distributed KV and attention-side design.
limitation: Long-context attention focus; not directly AFD.

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
why_it_matters: Baseline runtime and memory-management foundation for modern LLM serving.
limitation: Originally not designed around physical PD or AFD separation.

title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
why_it_matters: Important open runtime for modern high-throughput serving and MoE deployment practice.
limitation: Not itself a single disaggregation paper.

title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
why_it_matters: Foundation for iteration-level scheduling and continuous batching.
limitation: Predates most PD and AFD work.

title: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
why_it_matters: Foundational sparse-model and sharding work behind later MoE serving systems.
limitation: Training-oriented compared with modern serving papers.

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
why_it_matters: Popularized simple sparse expert routing at large scale.
limitation: Model architecture focus; not a serving system.

title: DeepSpeed-MoE: Advancing Mixture-of-Experts Inference and Training to Power Next-Generation AI Scale
why_it_matters: Early system substrate for MoE training and inference at scale.
limitation: Not designed around attention/FFN disaggregation.

title: Tutel: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts at Scale
why_it_matters: Important MoE system substrate for expert-parallel execution.
limitation: General MoE substrate rather than AFD policy.

title: FastMoE: A Fast Mixture-of-Expert Training System
why_it_matters: Earlier MoE system work that informs expert-parallel communication.
limitation: Training-oriented and earlier than current serving constraints.

title: Accelerating Distributed MoE Training and Inference with Lina
why_it_matters: Bridges MoE training and inference communication optimization.
limitation: Not an AFD-specific serving design.

title: Frontier: Simulating the Next Generation of LLM Inference Systems
why_it_matters: Simulation frameworks are essential for comparing disaggregated serving policies.
limitation: Simulator conclusions depend heavily on model calibration.

title: BurstGPT: A Real-World Workload Dataset to Optimize LLM Serving Systems
why_it_matters: Workload traces are needed to evaluate static versus adaptive disaggregation.
limitation: Trace availability does not by itself define a benchmark.

title: SpotServe: Serving Generative Large Language Models on Preemptible Instances
why_it_matters: Shows serving placement must handle unreliable and heterogeneous resources.
limitation: Not specific to PD or AFD.

title: SPAD: Specialized Prefill and Decode Hardware for Disaggregated LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Represents the hardware specialization side of the disaggregation argument.
limitation: Specialized hardware assumptions may not transfer to general GPU clusters.

title: Beyond the Buzz: A Pragmatic Take on Inference Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Useful skeptical baseline for claims that disaggregation always wins.
limitation: Broad perspective; not a full AFD boundary theory.

title: Revisiting Disaggregated Large Language Model Serving for Performance and Energy Implications
why_it_matters: Studies performance and energy tradeoffs for PD-disaggregated serving; throughput improvements need not imply energy savings.
limitation: Energy-optimized AFD remains open.

title: DynaServe: Unified and Elastic Execution for Dynamic Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Uses lead/follow GPU execution to adapt between colocated and disaggregated processing under changing demand.
limitation: Tandem execution differs from a strict fixed prefill-only/decode-only split; compare policies on equal resources.

title: Vidur: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework For LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Provides a profiled operator simulator and deployment search framework for serving experiments.
limitation: AFD, network congestion, and new architectures require explicit extensions and calibration rather than assumed support.

title: Mélange: Cost Efficient Large Language Model Serving by Exploiting GPU Heterogeneity
why_it_matters: Treats GPU selection as workload- and SLO-dependent cost allocation, useful for fair heterogeneous-serving baselines.
limitation: Heterogeneous allocation is not itself a phase or operator disaggregation policy.

title: How Far Can Disaggregation Go? A Design-Space Exploration of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Efficient MoE LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Compares AFD with chunked-prefill and P/D baselines across context lengths, prefix reuse, and latency constraints.
limitation: Evidence combines measured kernels with network simulation; validate conclusions on the target fabric.

title: AFD-Ledger: Deployment Provisioning for Attention--FFN Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Jointly provisions AFD and collocated deployments under matched workload, TPOT, hardware catalog, and budget.
limitation: Offline provisioning with bounded validation does not establish online elasticity or robustness to arbitrary workload shifts.

title: Rethinking Heterogeneous System Disaggregation for Subquadratic Attention
why_it_matters: Splits decode around quadratic versus subquadratic attention resource demands rather than attention versus FFN alone.
limitation: Hardware-proxy and analytical results need separate treatment from measurements on a deployed heterogeneous platform.

title: A Shape-Adaptive Architecture with Disaggregated Quantization for Efficient LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Co-designs shape-adaptive execution and phase-specific quantization for changing prefill and decode batches.
limitation: Custom accelerator design is not a drop-in GPU serving runtime or a cluster scheduling baseline.

title: Towards Load-Aware Prefill Deflection for Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Deflects prefill onto decode-side slack while protecting active decodes, avoiding KV transfer for those requests.
limitation: The reported DeepSeek-V2-Lite cluster evaluation does not establish the same behavior for large MoE or AFD.

title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Combines bounded prefill offload with in-place worker role reassignment to address transient and sustained imbalance.
limitation: Recent preprint; compare adaptation overhead, decode SLO protection, and workload sensitivity before generalizing.

title: Analytical Power-Aware Provisioning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated AI Inference
why_it_matters: Models serving-capacity and average-power Pareto fronts including input/output distributions and KV reservations.
limitation: Analytical provisioning is distinct from validated online DVFS, AFD control, and full-cluster energy measurement.

title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
why_it_matters: Specializes prefill/decode compute formats, weights, and storage placement and evaluates accuracy under disaggregated serving.
limitation: Additional weights and KV compatibility introduce memory, loading, and quality constraints; not all variants use separate GPUs.

title: Disaggregated Prefill and Decoding Inference System for Large Language Model Serving on Multi-Vendor GPUs
why_it_matters: Studies compatible KV transmission and joint parallelism/instance allocation across different GPU vendors.
limitation: Vendor-specific transport compatibility and deployment assumptions must be checked for each device pair.

title: SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer
why_it_matters: Overlaps proactive, on-demand, and speculative KV transfer to reduce the initial handoff barrier on limited networks.
limitation: Selective availability and model accuracy require validation; transfer-engine gains do not determine end-to-end SLO goodput.

title: NetKV: Network-Aware Decode Instance Selection for Disaggregated LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Adds network cost to decode-instance selection instead of using cache locality and compute load alone.
limitation: Reported evaluation is simulation-based; congestion telemetry and production overhead need independent measurement.

title: SpectrumKV: Per-Token Mixed-Precision KV Cache Transfer for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Allocates per-token KV precision and probes model tolerance to reduce transfer payload while retaining important tokens.
limitation: INT4 tolerance is model-dependent and lossy policies need quality evaluation alongside latency.

title: Lynx: Progressive Speculative Quantization for accelerating KV Transfer in Long-Context Inference
why_it_matters: Starts decoding from an anchor bit stream and verifies speculative progress after residual precision arrives.
limitation: Verification, rollback, and transfer overlap must be included when evaluating latency and output equivalence.

title: Efficiently Serving Large Multimodal Models Using EPD Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Separates multimodal encode, prefill, and decode stages and studies allocation and changing workloads.
limitation: Encode-stage memory, transfer payloads, and modality mix create additional constraints beyond text-only P/D.

title: vLLM-Omni: Fully Disaggregated Serving for Any-to-Any Multimodal Models
why_it_matters: Introduces a stage graph and connectors for independently serving autoregressive and diffusion components of any-to-any models.
limitation: Stage-level job-completion gains are not directly comparable to text-only TTFT/TPOT or AFD results.

title: EPD-Serve: A Flexible Multimodal EPD Disaggregation Inference Serving System On Ascend
why_it_matters: Combines stage orchestration, feature prefetching, and hierarchical KV transfer for multimodal serving on Ascend.
limitation: Ascend topology and co-location behavior need revalidation on GPU-based serving stacks.

title: EAServe: Encode-Aware Disaggregated Serving for Multimodal Large Language Models
why_it_matters: Uses encode-aware admission, partial prefill offload, and resource search to balance an EPD pipeline.
limitation: Results depend on modality mix, encode batching, and SM sharing; isolate these effects from the benefit of disaggregation.

title: Helix Parallelism: Rethinking Sharding Strategies for Interactive Multi-Million-Token LLM Decoding
why_it_matters: Reuses the same GPUs for KV-parallel attention and tensor/expert-parallel FFN, providing a temporal alternative to spatial AFD.
limitation: Targets long-context interactive decode; distinguish temporal sharding changes from dedicated attention/FFN worker pools. The linked runtime contains an implementation; follow its version-specific feature guide.

title: NVIDIA Dynamo
why_it_matters: Distributed serving framework with separate prefill/decode workers, routing, and deployment tooling.
limitation: Backend, connector, and deployment support are version-specific; this is a framework rather than a single paper.

title: NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library (NIXL)
why_it_matters: Pluggable inference data-transfer layer used by disaggregated serving and storage integrations.
limitation: Transport primitives do not implement a request scheduler, cache policy, or complete P/D service.

title: llm-d
why_it_matters: Kubernetes-native inference stack with reproducible deployment paths for P/D, KV reuse, and expert parallelism.
limitation: Requires compatible platform and backend components; an installation guide is not a portable performance guarantee.

title: TensorRT-LLM
why_it_matters: NVIDIA runtime with disaggregated-serving and parallelism implementation guides, including Helix.
limitation: Model, GPU, precision, and feature combinations must match the documented release.

title: AIPerf
why_it_matters: Client benchmarking toolkit with latency metrics, load control, and documented BurstGPT replay.
limitation: Length-only trace replay synthesizes prompts and does not reproduce original semantic prefix reuse.
